coordinates.locator: Centroid of OSM way 232494155 "PEP Interation Region 2" [sic], corroborated by building 620 on the official SLAC area map
coordinates.note: Correction from the campus-wide ROR point (5 km away) to the IR-2 hall footprint that housed BaBar; the footprint is an OpenStreetMap tracing, the building identity is corroborated by the official area map. Previous record: campus point 37.45383, -122.18219 at 1000 m precision, sources ['src:ror-05gzmn429', 'src:slac-wikipedia']; moved 2615 m (2026-09-21). The official SLAC area map is cited as the source identifying the building; the footprint itself is the OSM tracing.

name: PEP-II Interaction Region 2 (BaBar hall)
notes: No official SLAC page or the BaBar detector paper was fetched with a coordinate specific to IR2 in this session; the general SLAC campus point is reused here with a note, per A17 (a rank-12/geocoder-grade point cannot be promoted to `detector` kind).

2026-09-17: this record's own name/id asserts BaBar was at PEP-II's 'Interaction Region 2' (IR-2), but neither source previously cited (Wikipedia on SLAC, Wikipedia on BaBar) actually states this; the BaBar Wikipedia article was re-checked this session and does not mention IR-2 at all. Independently confirmed via a 2006 Phys.org article quoting BaBar's own control-room naming ('BaBar's Interaction Region 2 control room'); added as src:facilities-verify-babar-ir2-physorg (secondary, rank 12) so the IR-2 claim embedded in this record's name is no longer uncited.

summary.plain: The experimental hall at SLAC where the BaBar detector recorded collisions from the PEP-II B-factory.
summary.technical: PEP-II Interaction Region 2, SLAC campus, housing the BaBar detector (1999-2008); no coordinate distinct from the general SLAC campus point was found in this session (see note).
